notes.title: Meet the new Screen Recorder 2023!
notes.content:
We are constantly improving and adding new features to the program. 

The main updates are:


 Scrolling screenshots

No need to take endless screenshots anymore. Take scrolling screenshots to capture content that doesn't fit on the screen.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1497120/extras/Scrolling_screenshots.png?t=1681745780

 Drawing shapes on video

Convey your ideas more clearly now — add arrows, squares, or circles to highlight certain parts of your video.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1497120/extras/Drawing_shapes_on_video.png?t=1681745780

 Plus some other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.2 is here!
notes.content:
Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.2:

No need to worry about loud neighbors or colleagues any longer! Our new noise reduction feature will help you get rid of extraneous sounds.

 Audio control during capture
Forgot to turn the system sound on or disable the mic? Set your sound up during capture using the familiar buttons on the control panel.

 Minor improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: Great news!
notes.content:
Movavi Screen Recorder is your perfect buddy for work and study.

Here are the main features:

 Record the full screen or a program window
 Make screenshots and edit them right within the program. Share them via WhatsApp or Telegram
 Save multiple audio- and video- streams simultaneously
 Capture images from a webcam as standalone files
 Create a schedule for recordings to save your screen at any time
 Save cursor movements and record keystrokes
 Draw on screenshots while recording: highlight details and add comments
 Delete unwanted segments and use SuperSpeed mode for ultra-fast conversion
 Save videos and screenshots in many popular formats
 Upload files to YouTube and Google Drive

With Movavi Screen Recorder, you can easily create screencasts, record any video from the internet, save your desktop activity, and more. You can create any project you want, thanks to the easy-to-use interface.
